rationale: Because the Chief is in the majority and explicitly favors an institutionally modest, narrow Apprendi/Alleyne holding, he is most likely to keep the assignment and write to preserve a 7-2 coalition while leaving Almendarez-Torres formally intact. The most likely separate writings are a principal dissent by Justice Alito (administrability/recidivism-exception framing) with possible supplementation or separate dissent by Justice Thomas (original-meaning recidivism), and a concurrence from Justice Gorsuch (and possibly Barrett/Kavanaugh) emphasizing the narrowness and Sixth Amendment first principles.
